dog.description_text:
Found wandering alone in a cemetery, little Cali, just 6 months old, started her journey in fear and uncertainty. But brave girl is a determined survivor with a heart full of love.

Within just a few days of care and kindness, Cali bloomed into the sweetest, most affectionate pup. She’s treat-motivated, very social, loves to play her heart out, and has puppy energy for days! She’s already learned her commands and is always eager to please.

Cali is super social with dogs, getting along great with her foster siblings and other pups. She loves being in the middle of the fun, always curious, always ready to explore, and always down for a snuggle.

She is shy and protective but once she warms up, she’s a very playful girl who is looking for a forever home where she can continue to feel safe, loved, and free to be the joyful pup she was always meant to be.

Could Cali be your perfect match?
dog.name: Cali
